tasks.name: Clickstream Sessionization with Inactivity Gaps
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH lagged AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS prev_timestamp
    FROM user_events
),
session_boundaries AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_timestamp IS NULL
              OR event_timestamp - prev_timestamp > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_session_start
    FROM lagged
),
session_numbered AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        SUM(is_session_start) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM session_boundaries
)
SELECT
    user_id,
    session_id::BIGINT                AS session_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp)              AS session_start,
    MAX(event_timestamp)              AS session_end,
    COUNT(*)                          AS event_count
FROM session_numbered
GROUP BY user_id, session_id
ORDER BY user_id ASC, session_start ASC;

    SELECT
        user_id,
        event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN event_timestamp - LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp

                 OR LAG(event_timestamp) OVER (
                PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_timestamp
            ) IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_new_session

)

    MAX(event_timestamp) AS session_end,

tasks.name: Sequential Multi-Stage User Onboarding Conversion Funnel
tasks.reason: All correctness and performance checks passed
tasks.candidate_sql:
WITH first_view AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        MIN(event_time) AS first_view_time
    FROM user_journey_events
    WHERE event_name = 'view_item'
    GROUP BY user_id
),
first_cart AS (
    SELECT
        e.user_id,
        MIN(e.event_time) AS first_cart_time
    FROM user_journey_events e
    INNER JOIN first_view v
        ON e.user_id = v.user_id
       AND e.event_time > v.first_view_time
    WHERE e.event_name = 'add_to_cart'
    GROUP BY e.user_id
),
first_purchase AS (
    SELECT
        e.user_id,
        MIN(e.event_time) AS first_purchase_time
    FROM user_journey_events e
    INNER JOIN first_cart c
        ON e.user_id = c.user_id
       AND e.event_time > c.first_cart_time
    WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase'
    GROUP BY e.user_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.user_id)                                        AS total_viewers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id)                                        AS converted_cart,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id)                                        AS converted_purchase
FROM first_view v
LEFT JOIN first_cart     c ON v.user_id = c.user_id
LEFT JOIN first_purchase p ON c.user_id = p.user_id;
tasks.golden_sql:
WITH user_stages AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'view_item' THEN event_time END) AS view_time,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'add_to_cart' THEN event_time END) AS cart_time,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'purchase' THEN event_time END) AS purchase_time
    FROM user_journey_events
    GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS total_viewers,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL AND cart_time > view_time THEN 1 END) AS converted_cart,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN view_time IS NOT NULL AND cart_time > view_time AND purchase_time > cart_time THEN 1 END) AS converted_purchase
FROM user_stages;
